text: Morality [Lat. moralis , moral]: Ger. Sittlichkeit ; Fr. moralité ; Ital. moralità . (1) The relation of conduct or character to the moral standard. For different views as to the nature of the moral standard see ETHICAL THEORIES. ( W.R.S. ) (2) Disposition or conduct which is ethically good, contrasted with immortality. ( J.M.B. )
